name: Crazy Ride
desc: Crazy Ride is a 2019 arcade release by UNIS, in a similar vein to Sega's "Crazy Taxi" series. The player has a limited time frame to pick up and drop off as many passengers as they can in order to earn fares. Many different characters and vehicles are available for the player to choose. The player's car is equipped with several nitro boosts, and the player will see many different characters along the way, including a guitarist, and even Santa Claus.

name: Fantasy Soccer
desc:
Choose Your Team, Conquer the Field
Fantasy Soccer is a thrilling 2-player arcade game that lets you control a “fantasy” soccer team. Enjoy fast-paced matches, simple controls, and the unique experience of physically kicking a soccer ball for your shots. Immerse yourself in the world of fantasy football like never before in this multiplayer action-packed soccer game.

Game Specifications

1 to 2 player soccer action
Control one team member at a time using the joystick
Accelerate speed and switch players
Physically kick the soccer ball to shoot or slide tackle
Selectable teams from multiple countries

name: Mighty Moto
desc:
Mighty Moto is a ticket redemption, motorcycle racing arcade game for kids from UNIS. The game is designed with a smaller footprint and a smaller mounted bike to be more suitable to kids. Play on your own, or link up for competitive play, this game is fun and entertaining for kids of all ages.

Players choose from three unique tracks to race on, avoiding obstacles and using power ups to get to the finish line. With a 32" HD LCD monitor and bright LED lights and character and motorcycle selection, this game is a family friendly smash hit.

name: Night Hunter (multiguns)
desc:
Load up and get ready to hunt evil creatures of the night in Night Hunter by Universal Space. This is a sequel to After Dark that the company had released back in 2012.
Continuing with the story found in the After Dark game, Glenn is still on a quest to stamp out a demonic evil in the world that is wreaking havoc and laying waste to everything that crosses it’s path. You will face vampires, zombies, demons, animated statues and other bizarre monsters, all with a trusty cannon providing protection. The wheel feature from After Dark is still present and must be used during certain events when you need to steer an object or dodge an attack. The gun now has a new feature however – a lever that when pulled will switch between blue or red ammo. Certain enemies will also be blue or red; be sure to match the colors to deal out extra damage!

name: Wicked Tuna
desc: Wicked Tuna is the officially licensed game that immerses you in the thrilling world of the popular reality TV show. Dive into the deep sea adventure and experience the rush of the catch as you embark on your very own fishing expedition. This is not your ordinary arcade game; it’s a journey that captures the heart-pounding essence of “Wicked Tuna” and brings it to life in a whole new way.

name: Elevator Action Invasion (multiguns)
desc: Focusing on dual player shooting action, this action-packed game puts you into the shows of two well-armed special agents, who infiltrate a facility that has been overtaken by an army of evil cyborg soldiers. Take aim and earn combos to rack up the highest score, and use the elevator controls on the control panel to navigate through the complex.

name: Raccoon Rampage (multiguns)
desc: Raccoon Rampage is a 4-player water blasting game that will leave you craving for more action!  Rampage through the levels, collect valuable props, and unlock weapon boosts that will help you wreak havoc on your enemies. Collaborate with your fellow raccoon agents to strategically overcome obstacles and engage in epic boss battles that will put your skills and strategy to the test.  Get ready to go on a thrilling journey through filled with fun challenges!

name: After Dark (mulitguns)
desc:
Creatures of the underworld are rising up and only you can stop them!
After Dark is a fantasy-themed light-gun shooting game for 1-2 players. It features a theme similar to Van Helsing but with a great variety of enemies that they face. Using a mounted gun and the fully functioning steering wheel, players must face hordes of dark creatures in this arcade exclusive adventure.

name: Dino Invasion
desc: Dino Invasion is an arcade game by Universal Space Amusement. The game is a based on the company's previous rail shooter Outback Hunter, but with dinosaurs as the game's primary enemies.
